## Work in progress

::: {.paper}
::: {.paper-title}
Can Regressive Green Subsidies Be Justified by Abatement and Efficiency?
:::
::: {.coauthors}
with Joep Keuzenkamp
:::
::: {.abstract}
Subsidies for heat pumps mostly reach richer households. Is that defensible on
climate grounds? Using Dutch data on the national heat-pump subsidy, we ask
whether the extra emissions richer households cut, and what those cuts cost the
taxpayer, justify the pattern — and find that the case for favouring them is
weaker than it looks.
:::
::: {.paper-links}
[Abstract (PDF)](files/green-subsidies-abstract.pdf)
:::
*Draft coming soon — available on request.*
:::
